title: SI No. 2 of 2024 – Approved Enterprise (Safari Limited) Order, 2024
text:

BELIZE:
STATUTORY INSTRUMENT
No. 2 of 2024
ORDER made by the Minister responsible for Investment,
in exercise of the power conferred upon him by, section
3(5) of the Fiscal Incentives Act, Chapter 54, of the
Laws of Belize, Revised Edition 2020, and all other
powers thereunto him enabling.
(Gazetted 13th January, 2024)
1. This Order may be cited as the
Citation,
APPROVED ENTERPRISE (SAFARI
LIMITED) ORDER, 2023,
2. It is hereby declared that the principals of Safari Limited Declaration of
shall continue operating an auto rental company under Hertz, enterprise and
development
Dollar, and Thrifty brand located at #1 Goldson Lane, Belize enterprise.
City. Safari Limited (hereby called ‘the Company’) shall be
an approved enterprise under the Fiscal Incentives Act.
3. In addition to the conditions imposed under the Act, the
Special
Company shall- conditions.
(a) not practice, any discrimination on grounds
of ethnic, religious or political identity;
(b) observe all relevant laws that relate to safety,
social security, health and labour;
(c) pay fair wages to the workers and observe
fair labour practices,in accordance with the
Labour Act;
CAP. 297.

2 Fiscal Incentives [No. 2
(d) consult with the Belize Labour Department
before employing any person who is a non-
national or non-CARICOM nationals;
(e) ensure that any person employed who is not
a national of Belize or a CARICOM Member
State, is in possession of a valid work permit;
(f) provide training for staff in all aspects of the
operation and conduct of the Company including
management;
(g) submit a plan for training to the Ministry of
Labour for approval;
(h) satisfy the Ministry responsible for the
Environment, that all necessary measures have
been or will be taken to control any pollution
to the environment that may result from the
operation of the Company;
(i) satisfy the Ministry responsible for Culture,
that all measures have been or will be taken to
prevent the destruction of any ancient monument
or antiquity located within the Company’s area
of operation;
(j) maintain separate books for accounts and records
in respect of the Company;
(k) maintain the books of accounts and records in a
manner that conforms with generally accepted
accounting principles in Belize and appropriate
to the business in which the Company operates;
(l) conduct the business of the Company in
accordance with the relevant requirements
outlined under the ACT; or
(m) Ensure at least ten (10) persons are employed
by the company prior to 7th November, 2028.

4. Upon obtaining the written approval under section 4 of
Relief from
the Fiscal Incentive Act, the Company shall be permitted to duties.
import such quantity of items, free of customs duty and revenue
replacement duty, as shall have been proved unavailable from
suitable local products or raw materials, and necessary for the
establishment or expansion and operation of the Company,
and for the sole use thereof, but limited to-
(a) utility & transport vehicles (59 SUVs; 7 Pick-
ups; 3 Vans; 2 Electric Vehicles).
5. The duty exemption period shall be from the 8th Duty
November, 2023 to the 7th November, 2028. Exemption
Period.
6. The Company shall not be entitled to any tax holiday
Tax Holiday
period. Period.
7. This Approved Enterprise Order may be revoked if any Provision
condition to which it is subject is breached by the Company. relating to
revocation of
order.
Made by the Minister responsible for investment this 29th
day of December, 2023.
(HON. JOHN BRICEÑO)
